Latin word

maereō

maereō, maerēre

verb, second conjugation

be sad, grieve, mourn

In this lexicon

  • grieve

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Aul. 727: ējulāns conqueritur maerēns; Cic. Tusc. 1.30: nēmō maeret suō incommodō (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • Quīnam homō hīc ante aedīs nostrās ējulāns conqueritur maerēns?

    Who on earth is this, wailing and lamenting so sorrowfully in front of our house?Plaut. Aul. 727
